title: Kissed by Monsoon Filipino Fish Adobo Jjigae
description: A winey, chewy twist on traditional adobo, featuring the umami of fish sauce and aekjeot, and the savory depth of salt-baked fish. This plant-based-friendly dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner on the grill.

ingredients.name: Fish sauce
ingredients.notes: use high-quality, fermented sauce for depth of flavor

ingredients.name: Aekjeot
ingredients.notes: Korean fish sauce substitute with umami flavor

ingredients.name: Raclette cheese
ingredients.notes: melted on top for creamy, cheesy goodness

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Season the tilapia fillets with salt, black pepper, garlic, and ginger.
Salt-bake the tilapia fillets at 375°F for 10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, combine fish sauce, aekjeot, and patis in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, or until reduced and syrupy.
Grill the raclette cheese on the grill until melted and bubbly.
Assemble the dish by placing the cooked tilapia fillets on a plate, spooning the adobo sauce over the top, and sprinkling with raclette cheese.
Serve hot, garnished with sliced onion and a sprinkle of black pepper.
